It has also been suggested that reg-
istered dietitians and dietetic techni-
cians screen clients for lack of access
to food due to resource constraints by
using a single food sufﬁ ciency question: 
“Which of the following statements
best describes the food eaten in your
household?: (1) Enough of the kinds of
food we want to eat, (2) Enough but
not always the kinds of food we want
to eat, (3) Sometimes not enough to
eat; or (4) Often not enough to eat.”7
Incorporating questions from the
United States Department of Agricul-
ture food security survey module8 may
also be helpful.
